description: Compare a Korean law's articles before and after amendment (신구법), or show the Act, Enforcement Decree and Enforcement Rule side by side (3단 비교, three-tier). kind: 신구법 = old/new text of the latest amendment (changed text in 【 】); 3단 위임 = Act articles with the Decree and Rule articles they delegate to; 3단 인용 = lower-level articles citing the Act article. Three-tier output is long, so choose an article. Korean abbreviations work, and an English law name gets an English answer. With 신구법, edition 시행예정 shows what an amendment not yet in force changes.

article.description: Show only this article. E.g. 11, 제44조의4

edition.description: 신구법 only. 시행예정: old/new comparison of the amendment promulgated but not yet in force

law.description: Name of the Act in Korean or English. E.g. 근로기준법, 주택임대차보호법, 근기법, Labor Standards Act

name: compare_law
title: Compare old/new and three-tier (신구법·3단 비교)
